documentation_impact.assessment: Extend the merged notebook with JSON topology, recycle-aware routing, constrained physical optimization and a local TSA projection. Preserve earlier facility/PID/identification cases; update README and catalog. No NeqSim or TSA implementation changes.

coverage: 67-unit facility: total/component mass and enthalpy balances
54-point steady scan, constrained allocation and NeqSim replay
Analytical thermal-storage balance, chronological identification and held-out validation
Connected seven-model dynamic and zero-lag steady PlantSimulator replay
Six PidModel feedback loops, shared utility and header in one 14-model PlantSimulator
Native PID bounds, unsaturated nominal cases and limit/recovery stress
Typed CLR interface list, arrays, root namespace, enum and ref/out conversions
Plant JSON round trip, repeated execution and initialization-seed independence
Portable binding fixture and expected outputs; direct Python.NET harness self-check
PlantSimulator scaling through 96 PID loops and 194 connected models
Compressor fault residuals and independent temperature cross-check
24-unit native JSON PR oil-stabilization process, hydrocarbon recycle and two engineered return routes
Directed port graph, reachability, strongly connected components and recycle tear ordering
50-point two-route pressure scan, two-start SLSQP for each route and fresh native JSON replay
Per-evaluation total/component mass and energy closure; oil, driver, utility and discharge constraints
Graph-permitted full-plant local Jacobian, halved-step sensitivity check and eight-model PlantSimulator projection
Local step/ramp trajectories with assumed dynamics, nonlinear final-state replay and dynamic operating-limit checks
limitations: Reduced lumped thermal dynamics; no native vessel/pipeline transient qualification
Fixed composition, cooler temperatures and assumed off-design efficiency curves
Optimization is a local candidate inside the sampled domain
Empirical residual threshold is not a guaranteed probability bound
Network scaling timings compare different workloads, not simulator speedup
Official equinor/timeseriesanalysis-py wrapper repository and README returned 404; its API and execution are not validated
TSA 1.4.38 needs explicit steady PID output seeds for this multi-input graph; subsequent values are proven to come from simulation
Common utility is a prescribed lag, without load-to-utility feedback or a water energy balance
12 K utility stress can extrapolate beyond the identification domain; it is a numerical limit/recovery test
New stabilization case is inspired by comparesimulations2; no reproduction of its petroleum assay or benchmark results
JSON route choices are engineered alternatives, not arbitrary topology synthesis or proof of global optimality
Stable-oil and export-gas product-quality constraints, compressor maps, hydraulics and economics are outside this example
JSON alone does not determine TSA time constants; local projection uses explicitly assumed 10-90 s response times
Material recycle is solved in NeqSim; TSA receives full-process local sensitivities without duplicating material edges
